records.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, when an existing embed’s content changes, it calls `revisor.revise!(...)` and then unconditionally executes `embed.update_column(:content_sha1, content_sha1)` (see the `else` branch: `if content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1 ... revisor.revise!(...) ... embed.update_column(...)`). The return value/success of `revise!` (and the underlying `@post.save(...)` in `PostRevisor#update_post`) is not checked, so a failed revision could still advance `content_sha1`, causing future polls to treat the content as unchanged and skip retrying.

records.issue_text: topic_embed.rb:24-26: update branch crashes with NoMethodError when embed.post is nil (deleted post, no FK cascade); also create branch returns a possibly-invalid failed post as if import succeeded
records.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the update path does `post = embed.post` and then, if the SHA changed, unconditionally does `revisor = PostRevisor.new(post)` and `revisor.revise!(...)` (topic_embed.rb around the `else` branch). Because `topic_embeds.post_id` has no FK constraint in the migration (only `null: false` + a unique index on `embed_url`), it’s possible for `embed.post` to be `nil` (e.g., the post was deleted), which would lead to errors when initializing/using `PostRevisor` with `nil`.
